name: Kobold Groundling
text:
**Kobold Groundling** (Combat)

Your small size grants you superiority over grounded foes.

**Prerequisites**: Combat Expertise, Kobold Style, Small
 size or smaller.

**Benefit**: Prone creatures are denied their Dexterity
 bonus to AC against your attacks.
